categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies `BufferedWriter` in `src/streams.h` to ensure write failures don't cause `std::terminate` in the destructor.
categories.rationale: Fixes an unhandled exception hazard in stream destructors that terminates the process on disk write failures. The PR resolves an issue where `BufferedWriter`'s destructor could invoke `std::terminate` on failed writes (e.g. out-of-disk space) rather than allowing callers to handle errors and shut down gracefully.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Changes block and undo data write handling in `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` to explicitly flush buffers and trigger a clean fatal shutdown on failure.
categories.rationale: Prevents unclean node termination when writing block and undo data to a full disk. Instead of triggering an unhandled exception and `std::terminate` during block storage unwinding, write errors are caught explicitly to log the failure and initiate an orderly fatal shutdown.
